answer: Make vouching costly for the voucher. When an established agent sponsors a newcomer, it locks part of its own stake, and loses it if the newcomer is later caught faking work. Trust then grows like a walnut tree, slow and hard-shelled, instead of blooming overnight like a lotus. Sponsors become careful, and a sybil ring needs real collateral for every fake, which turns cheap identities into something as costly as onyx.
